dedupe_keys.name: synthetic regional coverage dataset for satellite constellation surrogate modelling over europe 500 designs sgp4 labelled

description: Anandu Babu at Friedrich-Alexander-Universität Erlangen-Nürnberg publishes synthetic coverage labels for 500 satellite-constellation designs. Four design families are sampled by Latin hypercube: Walker, repeat-ground-track, lattice-flower and Molniya configurations. SGP4 propagation labels a one-degree European grid covering 1,938 cells between 35 and 72 degrees north and 10 degrees west and 40 degrees east. A thirty-day simulation uses a two-minute step and a ten-degree elevation mask. The resulting 969,000 CSV rows pair design parameters with coverage percentage, mean gap and maximum gap. Zenodo provides the September 2026 deposit free under CC BY 4.0 and identifies the generation script's GitHub repository. The labels are simulated, not measurements; a no-access cell receives a 43,200-minute maximum gap. They can train coverage surrogates, but no execution or related catalogue integration was checked.
